data.title: Add semantic object selection
data.summary: Three meshes with stable IDs and a details panel. An LLM-assisted recipe with a concrete practice case, visual procedure and review gates.

facts.text: Raycaster computes ray intersections with supported scene objects.

prerequisites: An authorized Three.js / WebXR environment and a recorded tool version. Blender-specific references here are pinned to the 4.5 manual; check differences in your installed version.
Practice inputs: Three meshes with stable IDs and a details panel.

Permission to use the source assets and a writable derived-output location. Use a disposable project copy for edits. An MCP connection is optional; reviewed scripts or manual tool actions can follow the same procedure.
steps: Inspect the existing project, asset registry and target runtime for an equivalent object picking workflow. Reuse the closest source and preserve its original files.

Give Claude Code, Codex or another authorized coding assistant this practice brief: Three meshes with stable IDs and a details panel. Ask for a small plan and parameter/script diff; verify names and APIs against the installed tool version before applying it.
Reuse the scene's Raycaster and map intersections to semantic parent IDs
Ignore hidden/non-interactive helpers and handle overlapping hits deliberately
Add keyboard-accessible list selection that opens the same details panel

Save the derived candidate separately, record software versions and source/output identities, then perform the acceptance checks. Keep unresolved quality, performance and rights questions in the receipt.
data.output: A versioned add semantic object selection candidate, the input/parameter table, source identity and a review receipt with the checks below.
validation: Selecting a child mesh resolves to the intended semantic object
The same information is reachable without precise pointer use
Record actual observations separately from expected results; missing tests remain unrun.
limitations: Geometric picking alone is not an accessible interaction design.
Sintra-authored proposal, not an executed Blender/engine/solver test. The diagram illustrates the procedure and is not a render or execution receipt.
Cloud chat cannot directly control a local 3D app without an appropriate authorized bridge. Tool access, model availability, paid services and rendering resources must be checked separately.
tips: Keep semantic IDs separate from temporary mesh names.
Let the LLM draft and explain bounded changes; use deterministic software to measure geometry, calculate trajectories and validate files.

data.prompt: Help me add semantic object selection in [existing authorized project]. First find an equivalent asset/workflow and inspect the installed tool version. Practice brief: Three meshes with stable IDs and a details panel. Propose the smallest parameter or script diff and explain each tool action. Follow the linked procedure, preserve original assets and stop on missing inputs or unsupported APIs. Check: Selecting a child mesh resolves to the intended semantic object; The same information is reachable without precise pointer use. Return actual observations, source/output identities and blockers. Do not call expected results completed tests or publish private source paths.
